title: Rasalama Maritiora
description: Filmada's earlier chronology records the release of Rasalama Maritiora, a 22-minute docufiction directed by Philippe Raberojo for the centenary commemoration of the death of Rasalama, in 1937. The work is an early landmark in the history of filmmaking by Malagasy practitioners and needs fuller documentation.

sources.note: Recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; a primary or scholarly citation is still needed.
